welcome.body:
👋🏻 Hey! I'm *Whybee* — I turn your ideas into stunning images, videos, and audio using AI.

Just pick what you'd like to create and describe your idea. I'll handle the rest!
intake.describePrompt:
Great choice! Now tell me what you have in mind — describe it however you like 👇

Examples:
• Birthday poster for my friend Sarah
• Product shot of my sneakers
• A crocodile playing guitar on the moon
intake.imageOnly: 📸 Nice photo! What would you like me to create with it?
intake.style: What style are you going for?
intake.duration: How long should the video be?
intake.hasImages: Do you have any reference images?
intake.sendImagesNow: Send your reference images now (up to 5). Tap *Done* when finished.
uploading.prompt: Send your images now, or tap Done when you're ready.
uploading.imageReceived: ✅ Got image {count}! Send more or tap Done.
briefing.addMoreDetail: Sure! Tell me more and I'll update my understanding.
planning.revisePrompt: What would you like to change about the plan?
confirm.nudge: 👆🏻 Tap one of the buttons above to continue.
confirm.editPrompt: What would you like to change?
fulfillment.paymentPrompt: Like what you see? Pay below to get the full, watermark-free version delivered right here on WhatsApp. 🎉
fulfillment.refinePrompt: Not quite right? You can adjust your brief once more.
fulfillment.capHitMessage: ✨ Your content is ready and waiting! Pay below to unlock and receive it right here on WhatsApp.
fulfillment.refinementsExhausted: You've already refined this brief — pay to unlock your content, or type *reset* to start fresh.
fulfillment.delivering: 🎉 Your file is on its way — enjoy! 💫
status.awaitingPayment: ✨ Please complete your payment using the link sent above.
feedback.thanks: 💛 Thank you! Your feedback means a lot 🌟
feedback.sharePrompt: 🔥 Glad you loved it! Know someone who'd find this useful? Share our contact 👇
drafting.editApplied: Got it! Here's the updated brief:
drafting.imageAttached: 📸 Photo added! Here's the updated brief:
drafting.paymentPrompt: Love it? Pay below and I'll generate the final high-quality version — delivered right here on WhatsApp!
status.processing: ⏳ Hang on, still working on your last message...
status.generatingAfterPayment: 🎉 Payment received! Creating your masterpiece now — hang tight, you'll receive it in a jiffy!
errors.generic: 😔 Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.outputFailed: ⚠️ Something went wrong generating your file. Please try again.
errors.voiceNoteNotAccepted: 🙏 We don't accept voice notes for now. Please type your message.
errors.imageUploadFailed: 😔 Couldn't upload that image. Please try again.
